About.title: Software engineer, between code, sensors and data.
About.p1: I graduated as a computer science engineer from Polytech Nantes (class of 2026) and am currently completing a Master 2 MAE EI at IGR Rennes, where I complement my technical expertise with training in entrepreneurship and innovation.
About.p2: I master fullstack software development, embedded systems (IoT) and Data Science. Most recently, I designed an industrial edge-computing IoT solution on Raspberry Pi 5 that estimates animal weight through 3D vision.
About.p3: I am looking for my first permanent position (CDI) starting March 2027, to contribute to the design of innovative technology projects, drawing on my project management and innovation skills.
